item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 14
item.description:
11 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

Mounting

Animal Behavior

  • Fixed issue where multiple animals near a vehicle would not function correctly.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Map UI can now be closed properly after opening via bindings.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 13
item.description:

Animals & Resources
